name: avibe
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-8B (config.json max_position_embeddings 40960). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3-8B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 7.9 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2025-10-20. Caveats: net Russian-domain win, not a clean sweep - the card shows losses on gpqa_diamond_en (0.318 vs 0.369), math_500_en (0.714 vs 0.736), gsm8k_en (0.910 vs 0.927), ru_facts (0.718 vs 0.724) and both BFCL_V3 rows. Compared against "Qwen3-8B (no_think)", so the base ran with thinking disabled. Card writes decimals with commas.
